scripts.packages: npm run build --workspace=@pollo/geometry && npm run build --workspace=@pollo/contracts
scripts.dev: npm run packages && npm run dev --workspace=@pollo/backend
scripts.dev:web: npm run packages && npm run dev --workspace=@pollo/web

scripts.test: npm run packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
